fields.label: Company
fields.description: Company these WIP settings belong to. Defaults to the site's global default company; the WIP fields below only offer records of this company.

fields.label: WIP Warehouse
fields.description: Simple WIP pot for picked material. Only warehouses of the company selected above are offered.

fields.label: WIP Location (pot)
fields.description: Single sentinel location inside the WIP warehouse. Needed because the Storage Location dimension is mandatory on stock lines; it does NOT track location within WIP. Only locations inside the WIP warehouse above are offered.

fields.label: Allow customer-neutral (Own use) stock in customer picks
fields.description: Own-use stock carries no customer, so using it cannot mix customers. Untick to pick strictly customer-owned batches.

fields.label: FOB material categories
fields.description: Which Item Group in YOUR catalogue represents each material category. Used to route FOB (customer-owned) stock to per-customer warehouses. An item's group, or any group above it, must match one of these.

fields.label: Fabrics Item Group
fields.description: Item Group (or parent group) covering the first material category.

fields.label: Trimmings Item Group
fields.description: Item Group (or parent group) covering the second material category.

fields.label: Customer Warehouse Parent
fields.description: Group warehouse the auto-created per-customer warehouses hang under. Leave empty to use the company's root warehouse group.

name: WMS Settings
description: Phase 3a settings for the picking flow.
